name: revert-email-change
subject: You have requested to change your Abundance email address
previewText: Let us know if it wasn't you who requested the email change

fields.heading: You have requested to change your email address
fields.body:
Hello {first_name},

You recently requested an update to the registered email address you use for your Abundance account. We have sent an email to your new email address asking you to confirm this change.

If you did not request this change to your email address, please use the link below to cancel the request immediately:
